No evidence supports ACS (no troponin elevation reported, no ischemic ECG evolution like Q-waves or T-inversions), PE (no risk factors, normal CXR, no hypoxia/ABG data but dyspnea + pleuritic pain could mimic — however, effusion + ECG pattern is more specific for pericarditis), or pneumonia (normal CXR, no infiltrate or consolidation).
